name: Default
shortDescription: Synapse, the Matrix homeserver by Element, with PostgreSQL, federation on port 443 through a served .well-known and a persistent media store.

alerts.message: Public registration is disabled. Create the first (admin) account from the synapse container terminal with: register_new_matrix_user -c /config/homeserver.yaml --admin http://localhost:8008

The domain becomes the Matrix server name (user IDs look like @alice:your-domain) and is stored in every event and the signing key. Set the final domain before the first start; it cannot be changed later.
